headline: MIL @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 7.56 at COL 3.87, with a projected total of 11.43. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: MIL moved +2.16 runs while COL moved +1.29, changing the projected margin by +0.88 runs. The projected total climbed +3.45, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -24.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Shane Drohan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Tyler Freeman, Jake McCarthy, Troy Johnston, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins, Chad Stevens because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
